implementation: Brocade Cryptographic Library used in the interface module
description: Brocade cryptographic library used in the IPSec module implements crypto operations in hardware and in software. The Brocade MLXe series provides industry leading wire-speed port capacity without compromising the performance of advanced capabilities such as IPSec, IKEv2, IPv6, MPLS, and MPLS Virtual Private Networks (VPNs).
